subject: Terms workback: 8→16 GPU upgrade with staged activation & billing

Subject: Terms workback: 8→16 GPU upgrade with staged activation & billing

Sam,

Great to speak this morning — thanks for laying out Encompass's traffic expectations for Q1. Per our call, here's a pragmatic path to upgrade your reserved pool from 8 → 16 GPUs at renewal while minimizing disruption:

- Staged activation: activate 4 GPUs per week over four weeks (can compress to two waves if you prefer).
- Monthly commit: increase from $X,XXX to $Y,YYY (per-month committed spend reflects 16 GPUs). We'll provide a pro-rated bill for the month-of-activation.
- Throughput SLA: target 2.3× baseline throughput; we'll run a 72-hour post-activation acceptance window with sample prompt sets.
- Risk mitigations: fallback to 8-GPU variant automatically if latency SLOs are missed; KV cache warm-up runbook attached.

Attached: pricing-sku-8to16.pdf, staged-activation-runbook.md

If that looks reasonable I can draft an amendment and loop legal. Key asks from your side: preferred activation calendar and whether procurement needs net-30 billing on the order form.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198

Subject: Fwd: Encompass — upgrade ask (credits + SLA)

Folks — copying the Encompass thread. They asked for:

- Day-level proration and net-30 on first invoice
- Written throughput guarantee tied to acceptance tests + 24h rollback window
- One-month onboarding credit

Proposed commercial response:
- Offer 14-day pro-rated invoice for activation month, net-30 payment terms (finance signoff required)
- Provide a throughput commitment: 2.25× baseline 95th-pct token throughput over the 72-hour acceptance window; if missed, auto-fallback + 50% credit for that week. (This is our risk proposition.)
- Approve 1-month credit against monthly commit as a one-time onboarding concession.

Rishi — can you run numbers on unit economics (impact on committed ARR) and confirm finance ok with net-30 plus credit? Grace — ops: confirm we can do the staged activation and rollback in the runbook attached.

Thanks,
Marcus

Subject: Re: Terms workback: 8→16 GPU upgrade with staged activation & billing

Sam — quick update after internal alignment.

We can proceed under these terms:

- Billing/proration: activation-month will be pro-rated to the day. First invoice due net-30 from invoice date.
- Throughput & acceptance: 72-hour acceptance window post-final activation. Commitment = 2.25× baseline (95th pct token throughput). If throughput misses the commitment by >10% during the window, we will (a) roll back to 8 GPUs if requested and (b) issue a pro-rated credit equal to 50% of the difference for the affected week.
- Onboarding credit: one-time credit equal to one month's 16-GPU monthly commit applied on the first post-activation invoice.

Attached is a draft amendment we can send to your legal (DocuSign link below). If procurement approves net-30 and the activation dates below, I'll route to legal:
- Proposed activation calendar: Week of Nov 9 (4 GPUs), Nov 16 (4 GPUs), Nov 23 (4 GPUs), Nov 30 (4 GPUs). We can compress to two waves if you need faster ramp.

DocuSign (preview): https://www.docusign.com/EN-2026-0897/amendment

Let me know and I'll send the formal order form.

Best,
Marcus
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
